subject: End-of-Term settlement: final invoice, WHT reclaim evidence, and PO conversion
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@lumoshealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@lumoshealth.com, Tom Saito <tom.saito@lumoshealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final settlement docs and WHT reclaim - Lumos Health (DL-4821)

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well. We’re wrapping up the contract and need the final end-of-term invoice plus the evidence we’ll need to file for a withholding tax (WHT) reclaim on our side. Specifically: 

- One consolidated final invoice that shows the true-up adjustments and credits applied, with clear line items for base subscription, overage true-up, and credits.
- A PDF copy of the WHT certificate or any proof Redwood can provide so our tax team can include it with the reclaim filing.
- Confirmation of whether Redwood can accept Lumos’s PO (PO #4529) as the invoice reference or if you need a separate conversion/PO mapping.

We’re keen to close this in the current quarter. Can you confirm by COB Monday (Aug 24) whether you can provide the invoice and WHT evidence, and if the PO mapping is fine? If there are any outstanding credits to apply, list them in the invoice so we can match to our ledger.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Keller
Head of Revenue Operations, Lumos Health
anna.keller@lumoshealth.com
(415) 555-0162

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: finance@lumoshealth.com, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final settlement docs and WHT reclaim - Lumos Health (DL-4821)

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the PO. We can get this over to you this week. Quick summary of what we’ll provide: 

- Redwood_FINAL_EoT_Invoice_Lumos_4821.pdf (consolidated invoice with line-level true-up and applied credits).
- WHT_Certificate_Lumos_2025.pdf (Redwood-issued WHT evidence / withholding statement).
- PO crosswalk: we will record PO #4529 on the invoice and include a brief PO conversion appendix so your AP team can map it to your system.

A couple of asks so we include everything correctly:
1) Please confirm the billing currency you prefer on the final invoice — you previously asked for EUR display but payments will be wired in USD. We can show both if that helps.
2) We have an unused credit from the Q2 pilot (credit code: RWD-CR-209). Would you like that applied against the true-up (preferred) or issued as a standalone credit note?

I’m looping in Marcus (billing) and Vanessa (renewals) in case there are any accounting nuances we should be aware of. We’ll aim to send the invoice and the WHT certificate as separate attachments in a signed PDF by end of day Wednesday Aug 25.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Revenue Operations (EU & Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: Final settlement docs and WHT reclaim - Lumos Health (DL-4821)

Marcus / Vanessa — forwarding Anna’s request. Key points: Lumos wants consolidated EoT invoice + WHT evidence and wants PO 4529 on the invoice. They prefer closure this quarter.

Questions for you: 
- Marcus: can you confirm whether we should apply RWD-CR-209 directly to the invoice or issue a separate credit note? If applied, confirm expected net amount and the new total. Also confirm if we should show amounts in dual currency (EUR display / USD pay).
- Vanessa: any renewal/contract items to include in the narrative for the invoice (e.g., retention holdback or escrow line)? Also, if the customer signs for PO mapping, do we need a separate procurement acceptance doc?

I’ve attached the draft line items CSV — please update and return with final numbers by EOD. I’ll assemble the final PDF and WHT cert for signature.

Thanks,
Sofia

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Final settlement docs and WHT reclaim - Lumos Health (DL-4821)

Sofia / Vanessa — I ran the numbers and updated the draft. Summary: 

- Base subscription outstanding (prorated): USD 42,300.00
- Overage true-up (usage through July): USD 6,780.50
- Applied credit RWD-CR-209: USD (1,500.00) — applying this reduces the net due
- Gross total (USD): 47,580.50
- Tax footnote: Redwood does not withhold on outbound service payments in the US; we will provide WHT_Certificate_Lumos_2025.pdf which includes our certificate of non-withholding and a line noting any historical withheld amounts. 

Action items: 
- Sofia: please confirm dual-currency display — I prepared EUR equivalents using FX 1.08 (USD/EUR).
- Vanessa: confirm whether to include a one-line holdback description (we have 2% retention requested in the contract but it’s been waived per renewal email from May). I suggest we note the waiver in the invoice narrative to avoid confusion on their side.

I’ll attach the signed PDF invoice once Sofia confirms PO mapping and the dual-currency display.

– Marcus
Marcus Lin

Hi Sofia / Marcus,

Thanks — we’ve reviewed the draft. Confirmations: 

1) PO #4529 can be recorded on the invoice. No separate conversion doc needed on our end.
2) Please include dual display (USD invoice; show EUR equivalents for our internal reporting).
3) We accept the credit applied (RWD-CR-209).
4) The WHT certificate you provided (WHT_Certificate_Lumos_2025.pdf) is sufficient for our reclaim submission.

Can you send the finalized signed PDF and the invoice line-level CSV to finance@lumoshealth.com and include our PO number on page 1? Once received we’ll schedule payment within 30 days via wire.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Anna
